exhibits.title: Spot Price
exhibits.statement: Solana (SOL) traded at $100.81 as of 2026-10-29 17:52:58 UTC, -0.80% over one hour and -0.82% over twenty-four hours.

exhibits.title: 24-Hour Trading Range
exhibits.statement: Over twenty-four hours the price ranged from $99.2300 to $103.65; spot sits at 36% of that range.

exhibits.title: Seven-Day Trend
exhibits.statement: Price is -2.69% over seven days. The 24-hour average ($101.02) is above the 72-hour average ($100.95). Spot is 3.93% below the seven-day high of $104.93 and 1.59% above the seven-day low of $99.2300.

exhibits.title: Volatility & Momentum
exhibits.statement: Realized volatility computed from hourly closes is 2.29% per day. The 14-hour relative strength index reads 56.4, conventionally neutral.

exhibits.title: Liquidity
exhibits.statement: Twenty-four-hour trading volume was $3.2 billion, equal to 5.39% of the $59.49 billion market capitalization.

exhibits.title: Market Sentiment
exhibits.statement: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 51 ("Neutral"), versus 68 7 days earlier.

exhibits.title: Chainlink Price Feed
exhibits.statement: The Chainlink SOL/USD Data Feed on Ethereum mainnet last reported $101.27, 3.3 hours before the spot quote and +0.46% against the spot price in Exhibit A. Practice positions are entered and settled at this mark.

arguments.text:
May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price sits near the lower third of its 24‑hour range (36% of the $99.23‑$103.65 span) indicating room for upside as buyers re‑enter from oversold levels [Ex. B, C].  

2. Realized volatility is modest at 2.29% per day, providing a stable environment for a long, while the RSI of 56.4 signals emerging bullish momentum rather than overextension [Ex. D].  

3. Liquidity is robust, with $3.2 B traded in 24 hours—5.39% of market cap—ensuring execution at the Chainlink reference price of $101.27, which already trades a premium to spot, guaranteeing a favorable entry point for the practice position [Ex. E, G].  

The Bull rests.

May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price of SOL is firmly anchored near the lower third of its 24‑hour range, sitting at only 36 % of that band (Ex. B), indicating that any further downside must first breach the near‑term support at $99.23 before a meaningful rebound can be justified.  

2. Momentum metrics are neutral to slightly bearish: the 14‑hour RSI is 56.4 (Ex. D) and the seven‑day trend remains negative at –2.69 % (Ex. C), while the Fear & Greed Index has slipped to a neutral 51 from 68 a week ago (Ex. F), suggesting waning buyer enthusiasm.  

3. Liquidity is ample (Ex. E) but the Chainlink feed, the settlement benchmark, trades at $101.27—0.46 % above the spot (Ex. G), meaning a short position would be entered at a modest premium that the market can readily absorb without price distortion.  

For these reasons the Bear urges the Court to deny the Bull’s motion and keep the market open to a short practice position. The Bear rests.

Your Honor, the Bear’s first point collapses under Exhibit B: the price sits at 36 % of the range **above** the low, not “near‑term support”; there remains ample room to the $99.23 floor, and the 24‑hour average ($101.02) sits above the 72‑hour average ($100.95), indicating upward bias (Ex. C).  

Second, the Bear mischaracterizes momentum. Exhibit D shows realized volatility of 2.29 % per day—high enough to generate short‑term spikes—while the RSI of 56.4 is well into neutral territory, not bearish. Moreover, the Chainlink feed premium (Ex. G) is modest, but settlement at $101.27 still exceeds the spot, meaning any short would be entered **above** current market, reducing upside, not creating distortion. Nothing further.

Your Honor, the Bull’s claim of “room for upside” is hollow: the price sits only 36 % up the 24‑hour range and is already 3.93 % below the seven‑day high, showing limited upside potential versus a still‑falling seven‑day trend of –2.69 % [Ex. B, C]. Moreover, the “emerging bullish momentum” argument collapses under the neutral RSI of 56.4 and a Fear & Greed Index now at 51, down from 68 a week ago, indicating waning enthusiasm rather than strength [Ex. D, F]. These factors together outweigh any perceived liquidity advantage. Nothing further.

ruling.holding: The Court finds a short practice position is warranted.

findings.finding: Spot price is $100.81, down 0.82% in 24h, indicating slight weakness
Seven‑day trend is –2.69% and price sits 3.93% below the seven‑day high
Fear & Greed Index fell to neutral 51 from 68 a week ago, showing waning sentiment
RSI at 56.4 is neutral and realized volatility is modest, offering no strong bullish impetus
Chainlink settlement price $101.27 trades above spot, allowing a short to be entered at a slight premium

ruling.opinion: The record shows SOL modestly down and in a declining seven‑day trend (Ex. C). Sentiment has slipped to neutral (Ex. F), and momentum indicators remain non‑bullish (Ex. D). The settlement feed is priced above spot, giving a short entry at a modest premium (Ex. G). Combined, these factors outweigh the Bull’s liquidity argument, supporting a short practice position.
ruling.dissent: The Bull points to a stable volatility environment and a price positioned above the low of its 24‑hour range, suggesting limited downside risk and potential for upside rebounding.
